Illustration: a pinball machine seen from above. The playing field has colourful round bumpers and two white flippers at the bottom. At the right edge is a narrow launch channel, at the bottom of which a steel ball rests on a plunger supported by a spring. A hand pulls the plunger knob down, which compresses the spring.
Kaavakuva, ei mittakaavassa: kolme tilan: Diagram, not to scale: three situations one below the other. A trolley is attached to a horizontal spring whose other end is fixed to a wall on the left. The vertical dashed line is the equilibrium position x = 0. At the top the trolley has been moved to the right, the spring is stretched, and the spring force F points to the left, towards the equilibrium position. In the middle the trolley is at the equilibrium position, the spring is at its rest length and there is no force. At the bottom the trolley has been moved to the left, the spring is compressed, and the spring force points to the right, towards the equilibrium position. The position x of the trolley is shown by a thin black dimension arrow, the force by a red arrow.
Kaksi kuvaa allekkain. Ylhäällä käsi ven: Two pictures one below the other. At the top a hand stretches a spring fixed to a wall, to the right. At the bottom the spring and the hand are drawn apart: the force of the hand F_v acts to the right on the right end of the spring, and the force of the spring F acts to the left on the hand. The arrows are equally long: the forces are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction, and they act on different objects.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa, keksityt esimerkk: Graph to scale, made-up example values: on the horizontal axis the extension x in metres from zero to 0.125, on the vertical axis the force F_v stretching the spring in newtons from zero to five. Five measurement points lie close to a straight line through the origin. Two points have been chosen on the line, x 0.025 metres with force 1.0 newtons and x 0.100 metres with force 4.0 newtons, and between them a gradient triangle has been drawn whose sides are Δx and ΔF_v. The gradient of the line is the spring constant k.
Kaavakuva ilman lukuarvoja: suora F v =: Diagram without numerical values: the line F_v = kx going up from the origin. On the horizontal axis the extensions x and 2x, on the vertical axis the forces kx and 2kx. The triangle under the line for extension x is coloured orange and labelled E_p: its base is x and its height kx. The larger triangle for extension 2x is divided by dashed lines into four identical triangles, one of which is coloured, so its area is 4 E_p.
Kaksi kuvaa vierekkäin. Vasemmalla tilan: Two pictures side by side. On the left the situation: a spring balance hangs from a hook, and a fish hangs at rest from the hook at its lower end. On the right the free-body diagram of the fish, the fish as a rectangle: weight G from the centre downwards and spring force F from the middle of the upper surface upwards, equally long. In the corner the y-axis pointing up.
Opiskelijan piirtämä voimakuvio jousesta: Free-body diagram drawn by a student of an object hanging at rest from a spring, the object as a rectangle. From the centre an arrow G straight down. From the middle of the upper surface an arrow F_1 straight up, as long as G. From above the upper surface, a little to the side, an arrow F_2 straight down as far as the upper surface, as long as G.
Mallikuvio: laatikko suorakulmiona vaaka: Model diagram: a box as a rectangle on a horizontal floor. Weight G from the centre downwards. Support force N of the floor from the lower surface upwards, equally long. Spring force F from the middle of the right side horizontally to the right and kinetic friction F_μ from the left corner of the lower surface to the left, equally long, about a third of the length of the weight. Separately a blue velocity arrow v to the right. In the corner the axes x to the right and y up.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa, keksitty esimerkk: Graph to scale, made-up example data: on the horizontal axis the extension x of the spring in centimetres from zero to 12, on the vertical axis the force F_v stretching the spring in newtons from zero to 3.5. Six measurement points: 1.7 centimetres and 0.49 newtons, 3.2 and 0.98, 5.0 and 1.47, 6.4 and 1.96, 8.3 and 2.45, and 9.8 centimetres and 2.94 newtons. No line has been drawn.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: vaaka-akselilla j: Graph to scale: on the horizontal axis the extension x of the spring in metres from zero to 0.25, on the vertical axis the force F_v stretching the spring in newtons from zero to 15. The line starts from the origin and rises steadily; it passes through grid points, for example at extension 0.10 metres the force is 6 newtons.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: vaaka-akselilla v: Graph to scale: on the horizontal axis the extension x in metres from zero to 0.12, on the vertical axis the force F_v stretching the spring in newtons from zero to eight. Two lines starting from the origin: the line of spring A is steeper and passes through the point 0.10 metres, 6.0 newtons; the line of spring B is gentler and passes through the point 0.10 metres, 2.5 newtons. The line of B is dashed.
